newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares ride highs with bluechip support.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares ride highs with bluechip support.

text.p: Swedish shares continued to trade at new highs on Friday with support from the heavyweight stocks.
At 1150 GMT the Stockholm general index was 0.78 percent higher at 3,072.54 after shares worth 2.26 billion crowns had changed hands.
The most traded share was drugs major Astra that rose 3.5 to 151 crowns after trading up in New York overnight with sentiment about the stock positive.
The U.S. investment bank Lehman Brothers has raised its share price level on Astra to 160 crowns.
Ericsson rose 3.5 to 315.5 crowns, boosted by the general optimism in the market.
Appliance maker Electrolux jumped 15 to 582 crowns. It said it was looking at possibly closing or selling two of its factories in Sweden as part of its plan to cut jobs and plants worldwide.
"Dresdner Kleinwort Benson has recently lifted its buying recommentation on the share," one broker said.
